identity_algorithm.parser: strict UTF-8 streaming top-level-array parser; every row parsed
identity_algorithm.sequence: SHA256 of concatenated 32-byte per-row SHA256 digests

rl.acquisition_policy: temporary file plus atomic hard-link create; existing targets validated; no overwrite path exists

drive_header_observation.method: direct HEAD to each official Drive item ID

sft.lineage_evidence: Files are untracked under a local clone whose origin is the official repository and whose HEAD is the pinned commit. Names and byte lengths match Drive HEAD metadata. No local acquisition receipt or official checksum was found, so byte equality to Drive is not proven.
sft.pickle_policy: raw bytes hashed only; pickle is not deserialized because it can execute code and official main_train.py leaves instances=None

upstream.data_license_scope: NO_SEPARATE_LICENSE_OBSERVED_FOR_GOOGLE_DRIVE_DATA; do not infer that the repository MIT license governs externally hosted bytes
upstream.readme_data_claim: data generated in the original paper
